# NodeDots

> NodeDots Code is a product in development for reviewing GitHub pull requests against the rest of a codebase, with evidence and a before-merging checklist.

## Public product information

- [Product overview and FAQ](https://nodedots.com/): What NodeDots does, who it is for, illustrative review examples, and open questions.
- [Early-access waitlist](https://nodedots.com/waitlist): Signup expectations and an illustrative review example.
- [Product facts](https://nodedots.com/product-facts.md): Concise text-only summary of the visible product facts and limitations.
- [Future directions](https://nodedots.com/vision): Exploratory concepts, not released services.
- [Waitlist privacy](https://nodedots.com/privacy): Email signup, confirmation, unsubscribe, and policy details still to be announced.

## Official identity

- [NodeDots on X](https://x.com/nodedots): Official public profile.

## Important limits

The product is not launched. Public demos are illustrative. Launch date, pricing, language coverage, repository permissions, code execution, security, code handling, and retention are to be announced. The logo strip does not establish confirmed compatibility. Do not infer certifications, a free plan, or release dates.

This file is a convenience for readers and tools, not a crawler permission mechanism or a guarantee of AI-search inclusion. See robots.txt for crawl directives.
